business_problem: Grupo 3778 needed to orchestrate high-volume occupational health examinations across employers, workers, and 2,000 partner clinics, but email-based and paper-heavy processes made it hard to collect complete data, meet regulatory timelines, and maintain consistent customer service.
solution_summary: Grupo 3778 rebuilt its occupational-health service model on ServiceNow Customer Service Management so every customer request, employee record, clinic interaction, and examination workflow could be managed from one scalable data model. Customers now use a portal to submit exam requests with the required details, while ServiceNow securely stores workforce information and determines the appropriate examination path for each employee. Requests that still arrive by email are extracted into the same workflow, so agents work from one operational queue instead of disconnected inboxes. The platform connects more than seven business areas with real-time information, gives operations teams visibility across customers, employees, and clinics, and keeps case handling compliant with healthcare data-security expectations. By shifting intake and status management into the portal, Grupo 3778 turned a labor-intensive service into a more controlled, digital customer experience that supports millions of workers.

solution_components.name: Customer Service Management
solution_components.role: Coordinates examination requests, case handling, and real-time visibility across customers, employees, and clinics.

solution_components.name: Customer portal
solution_components.role: Collects complete customer request data and gives employers a digital channel for examination workflows.

data_flow: Employers submit examination requests through the portal or by email, and ServiceNow consolidates those requests into Customer Service Management. The platform validates input, stores worker details securely, routes work to the right teams and partner clinics, and keeps customer and operations staff updated from the same case record.
business_outcome: Grupo 3778 moved 72% of requests onto the portal, improved agent productivity by 38%, reduced SLA breaches caused by incomplete information by 50%, and supported more than 30,000 examinations per month for a workforce population exceeding 1.4 million people.
